verdict.rationale: RUN ships an AI virtual assistant and AI-enabled features, so letting it connect to external MCP servers is a fair question for this product. The evidence pack never mentions MCP client support or any way to attach external tool servers to its AI. App-marketplace integrations and API Central are a different capability: they are developer and integration building blocks, not MCP-client tool use, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
